definitions.gloss: traffic control; traffic restriction; road closure
definitions.explanation: The regulation or restriction of vehicle and pedestrian traffic, typically by police or authorities, due to events, accidents, construction, or other reasons.

examples.japanese: {交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be traffic restrictions due to a marathon event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}かれ→敷く：00366_shiku⟧、⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic restrictions were imposed over a wide area due to the typhoon, greatly affecting commuters.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (traffic) and ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧ (regulation/restriction). A common term in daily life, often encountered in traffic information on radio, TV, and navigation apps. In Japan, traffic is frequently restricted for festivals, marathons, VIP motorcades, and natural disasters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}かれる→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: traffic restrictions are imposed
- {交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: traffic restrictions are lifted
- {交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: traffic restriction information
- {交通規制|こうつうきせい}⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧: restricted traffic section

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧: road closure — complete blocking of a road
- ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧: traffic jam — congestion, often a result of {交通規制|こうつうきせい}
- {迂回路|うかいろ}: detour — an alternate route around restricted areas
